notes: Breadboard holes follow the catalogue naming: rows a-e are bank 't', rows f-j are bank 'b'. The image labels its upper half j-f and its lower half e-a, so the LED sits in the image's upper half (bank 'b', row g) and the resistors straddle the centre gap (row f to row e).
Column positions were read from the image. The LED legs R, COM, G, B are in columns 9, 10, 11, 12. The three resistors are in columns 9, 11, 12 and the red 5V wire is in column 10.
The 5V wire (wire1) runs from the Uno 5V pin to 10b.f, which is in the same strip as the LED's long common-anode leg at 10b.g.
The cathode channels are: pin 3 to r1 to red, pin 5 to r2 to green, pin 6 to r3 to blue. Each wire lands in the row-e strip of its resistor's column: orange 9t.d, green 11t.c, blue 12t.b.
The sketch comment says 'Anode: GND', but the text, circuit image and schematic all connect the common anode to 5V. I followed the circuit.
Each physical electrical connection has both a joined and an electrical edge.
